Smart stream recovery

If a stream drops, BYO Player tries to reconnect and switch to a backup source for the same channel automatically, before asking you to do anything.

Automatic stream recovery

Personalisation

BYO Player learns from what you watch, search for, favourite and skip, and uses it to personalise your Home screen and recommendations. Everything stays on this TV, tied to this profile.

Personalised recommendations
Use watch history
Use search history
Use viewing-time patterns

Resetting clears what BYO Player has learned for this profile. It does not delete your watch history or favourites.

Posters & info

Fetch real poster artwork, plots, genres and ratings for your Movies & Series from TMDB (The Movie Database). Your playlist only carries titles and per-episode images, so this fills in proper artwork and descriptions.

Enrich with TMDB artwork & info

Get a free key at themoviedb.org → Settings → API → request a Developer key (takes ~2 minutes). Paste the API Read Access v3 key above. Lookups are cached on this TV, so each title is fetched only once.
